- Fix GitHub downloads in the PS5 updater.
- Add a Settings scrollbar and move Updates to the bottom.
- Show brief release notes before downloading.
- Improve Discover frame pacing, catalog browsing and request management.

Install the complete folder ZIP in `/data/homebrew/PPSA99001`. This version fixes
downloads but still has an installer permission issue. Use 1.08 or newer for
in-app installation. Login and preferences are preserved.
